يعلوليا (form XII)
# يَعْلَوْلِيَا (yaʕlawliyā) /jaʕ.law.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# يُعْلَوْلَيَا (yuʕlawlayā) /juʕ.law.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
